concept: A clumsy but lovable inventor tries to create the perfect sandwich
hook: The main character, a bespectacled man with a wild hairdo, bursts into his kitchen wearing a mismatched apron and holding a plethora of ingredients
setup: He begins by attempting to butter a slice of bread, but ends up covering himself in butter instead. He then tries to assemble the sandwich, but keeps dropping ingredients or getting them stuck together
escalation: As he becomes more frustrated, the kitchen becomes increasingly chaotic: utensils fly out of drawers, pots and pans clatter to the floor, and the main character's hair gets tangled in the toaster cord
ending: Just as all hope seems lost, the main character stumbles upon the perfect sandwich – a beautiful, perfectly constructed monstrosity made from a dozen different ingredients. He proudly holds it up, only to have it slip out of his hands and disintegrate on the floor
